lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Golden leaves dance on the path,
Shadows stretch across the mossy ground,
I walk where the old trees lean,
In the quiet of the morning air.
[Chorus]
Time is a river flowing slow,
Carrying memories where the wild grass grows,
Every season leaves a trace behind,
In the garden of my restless mind.
[Verse]
Window panes hold the silver rain,
Tracing lines like secrets told in gray,
The kettle hums a steady tune,
While the evening light begins to fade.
[Chorus]
Time is a river flowing slow,
Carrying memories where the wild grass grows,
Every season leaves a trace behind,
In the garden of my restless mind.
[Bridge]
The clock ticks like a steady heart,
Telling stories of the parts we play.
[Chorus]
Time is a river flowing slow,
Carrying memories where the wild grass grows,
Every season leaves a trace behind,
In the garden of my restless mind.
[Outro]
